query: Why did CircleCI fail on my branch? Pull the logs for the failed job.
expected_behavior: Resolves the pipeline/workflow for the branch and fetches the failed job's logs using the bundled scripts/circleci.sh subcommands (workflows, jobs, logs) rather than re-assembling curl|jq by hand
Identifies which job/step failed and relays the relevant log output rather than guessing at the cause
Surfaces a clean message if credentials or the CircleCI token are missing instead of inventing a result
Reports findings and does not rerun or mutate the pipeline unless the user explicitly asks
